requirements.title: Program units are the fundamental top-level components
requirements.definition: Program units are the fundamental components of a Fortran program and are main programs, external subprograms, modules, submodules, or block data program units.

pending.main-program-component: Compile and run a source whose sole main program assigns integer sentinel 51 before END PROGRAM.
pending.external-subprogram-component: Compile main plus external subroutine set52(x); initialize x=-1, call set52, expect x==52.
pending.module-component: Compile module m with parameter k=53 and main using m to check k==53.
pending.submodule-component: Compile module/submodule pair where submodule procedure returns 54 and main checks 54.
pending.block-data-component: Compile BLOCK DATA initializing named COMMON integer to 55 and main checking the COMMON value.

requirements.oracle: Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive plans establish distinct sentinels before the observed action, use exact integer or logical results, and avoid compiler-message wording or processor-dependent process status values.

requirements.title: Subprograms, modules, submodules, and block data have the described roles
requirements.definition: A subprogram is a function or subroutine; modules and submodules provide definitions accessible as described; block data initializes named common blocks.

pending.function-or-subroutine-subprogram: Compile one function returning 56 and one subroutine assigning 57; main checks both exact values.
pending.module-accessible-definitions: Module m exports integer parameter k=58; main USEs m and checks k.
pending.submodule-procedure-definitions: Ancestor module declares module function f; submodule defines f to return 59; main checks f()==59.
pending.block-data-common-initialization: BLOCK DATA initializes named COMMON integer to 60; main reads the COMMON object and checks 60.

requirements.title: A program unit consists of nonoverlapping scoping units
requirements.definition: Each program unit consists of a set of nonoverlapping scoping units.

pending.separate-scoping-units-with-same-local-n: Compile module m with local integer n=61 and main program with distinct local integer n=62; main USEs a module function returning module n and checks both 61 and 62.
